name: @datagrok/chem
description: Cheminformatics support: import, rendering, sketching, calculation of properties, predictive models, augmentations, multiple analyses.

properties.name: ChemicalEngine
properties.description: Engine behind Chem's own chemistry, Contains / Not contains substructure searches included. With Crux, molecules are drawn and searched, descriptors, fingerprints and structural alerts calculated and the scaffold tree built by Crux; RDKit does the rest, and any molecule or call Crux cannot handle. Other packages get RDKit objects from Chem in both modes (getRdKitModule, getRdKitService); in Crux mode the pictures and values of the moved functions come from Crux.

properties.name: HighlightColor
properties.description: Color of highlighted substructures that have no color of their own, such as the matches of the substructure filter. A molecule column can override it in Chemistry | Rendering.

properties.name: UnspecifiedStereoIsUnknown
properties.description: Draw stereocenters with unspecified configuration with a wavy bond, and double bonds with unspecified E/Z configuration as crossed bonds. A molecule column can override it in Chemistry | Rendering.

properties.name: SimplifiedStereoGroupLabel
properties.description: When all stereocenters of a molecule are in one AND or OR enhanced stereo group, label the molecule once ("AND enantiomer", "OR enantiomer") instead of each stereocenter ("and1", "or1"). A molecule column can override it in Chemistry | Rendering.

properties.name: TemplatesPath
properties.description: File path to the reaction templates CSV (reaction SMARTS) loaded by default in the Reaction Enumerator

properties.name: BuildingBlocksPath
properties.description: File path to the building blocks CSV (SMILES) loaded by default in the Reaction Enumerator

properties.name: ReagentsPath
properties.description: File path to the reagents CSV (SMILES) loaded by default in the Reaction Enumerator; empty for none
